extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: SI2305, Guangdong Hottech, p-channel MOSFET.

The supplied PDF states no revision identifier and contains three pages: maximum ratings and static/dynamic electrical characteristics on p. 1, switching and body-diode electrical characteristics on p. 2, and typical characteristic plots on p. 3.
P-channel polarity and signed source values are preserved. The VGS(th) table provides MIN = -0.5 V and MAX = -0.9 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA; TYP is blank and is represented as null.

RDS(on) rows are transcribed as inclusive maximum values: 45 mOhm at VGS = -4.5 V and ID = -3.5 A, 60 mOhm at VGS = -2.5 V and ID = -3 A, and 90 mOhm at VGS = -1.8 V and ID = -2 A; all are pulse-test rows with pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 2%.

Ciss = 740 pF and Crss = 190 pF have blank condition cells in the p. 1 table; their conditions are not inferred. Coss = 290 pF retains the explicitly printed VDS = -4 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz condition. Values are converted to farads.
The VSD table provides MAX = -1.2 V at IF = -3.3 A and TA = 25 degC; the inclusive maximum is used for body_diode. The p. 3 typical body-diode plot is also included.

Additional p. 1 and p. 2 tabulated fields not represented by the strict schema include VDS = -12 V, VGS = +/-8 V, ID = -4.1 A, IDM = -10 A, PD = 0.35 W, Tj/Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, RthetaJA = 357 degC/W, IGSS, IDSS, gfs, gate charge, gate resistance, switching times, and IS/ISM; they are retained only in this note with page citations.

Curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 3. No points were generated by interpolation between source values. Resistance plot values are converted from mOhm to ohm and retain the plotted signed voltage/current axes.
